controles.affirmation: Les passifs sur remboursements clients LIES AU PLAN GTF s'elevaient a 3,103 Mds EUR fin 2025, soit environ 71% des capitaux propres du groupe
controles.verbatim_source: Refund liabilities in the amount of EUR3,103 million (previous year: EUR3,305 million) are also recognized under current liabilities. THESE REFUND LIABILITIES INCLUDE RESIDUAL OBLIGATIONS AMOUNTING TO EUR231 MILLION arising from the stake in the approved compensation payments to PW1100G-JM program customers under the GTF fleet management plan during the reporting period and the previous year. Refund liabilities fell by EUR202 million compared to December 31, 2024. || Detail de la note : "Warranty and liability risks 485 950 | Invoice corrections / subsequent costs 2,618 2,355 | Total refund liabilities 3,103 3,305"
controles.correction_proposee: Erreur la plus grave du lot, repetee deux fois (bloc fondamental_interne et bloc quantitatif). Seuls 231 M EUR des 3 103 M EUR se rapportent au plan de gestion de flotte GTF. Le solde correspond aux risques de garantie et responsabilite (485 M EUR) et aux corrections de facturation / couts ulterieurs du systeme de facturation en plusieurs etapes (2 618 M EUR), sans lien avec le GTF. Le rapport aux capitaux propres est donc d'environ 5,3% (231/4 375), pas 71%. Reformuler : "les passifs sur remboursements clients totalisent 3,103 Mds EUR fin 2025, dont 231 M EUR au titre du plan GTF".

controles.affirmation: MTU chiffre son exposition 2026 DU PLAN GTF sur le resultat a environ 192 M EUR contre 161 M EUR un an plus tot, et sur la tresorerie a environ 255 M EUR contre 237 M EUR
controles.verbatim_source: Overall assessment of MTU's risk exposure ... Based on quantifiable risks (>EUR10 million) evaluated in the risk management process, FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2026, MTU DERIVES RISK-BASED EARNINGS EXPOSURE based on experience of around EUR192 million (previous year: EUR161 million). The OEM segment accounts for around EUR159 million of this, particularly in the "Programs & Projects" category, and the MRO segment for the remainder. ... In 2026, the identified risk factors could reduce liquidity by approximately EUR255 million (previous year: EUR237 million).
controles.correction_proposee: Ces montants ne sont pas l'exposition du plan GTF : c'est l'exposition globale au risque de MTU pour l'exercice 2026, agregee sur TOUTES les categories de risque quantifiables (>10 M EUR), tirees du processus de gestion des risques. L'ATT les presente sous un titre "Cout recurrent du plan de gestion de flotte GTF", ce qui les impute a tort a ce seul plan. Reformuler : "pour 2026, MTU evalue son exposition globale au risque a environ 192 M EUR sur le resultat et 255 M EUR sur la liquidite, toutes categories de risque confondues".

controles.affirmation: Citation : Despite the tough risk situation, especially driven by the extended GTF fleet management plan
controles.verbatim_source: All in all, taking into account the compensatory measures, at present MTU has not identified any risks that could jeopardize its status as a going concern. Despite the tough risk situation, especially driven by the extended GTF fleet management plan, MTU CONSIDERS THE RISK SITUATION TO BE MANAGEABLE, especially given the measures taken in this respect and the management system that is in place.
controles.correction_proposee: Le fragment cite est litteral, mais il est coupe juste avant la proposition principale de la phrase, qui dit l'inverse de ce que la citation suggere (MTU juge la situation de risque maitrisable et n'identifie aucun risque de continuite d'exploitation). Citer la phrase entiere ou expliciter la reserve.

controles.affirmation: RRSP - responsabilite portee par le consortium au prorata des contributions independamment de la faute ; le chef de file peut regler seul une reclamation ; MTU peut supporter une responsabilite pour des defauts sans lien avec ses propres produits. Partenaires : Pratt & Whitney, GE Aerospace, IAE LLC, IAE AG
controles.verbatim_source: In most of these relationships, liability for third-party claims is borne by the consortium or the partners on the basis of their respective contribution to the consortium or RRSP, irrespective of the fault of the individual partner. In these RRSP programs, the consortium lead generally has the right to settle third-party claims unilaterally on behalf of all program participants. Consequently, MTU may be exposed to substantive liability for defects unrelated to the performance of its products. || The OEMs with which MTU has RRSP contracts include Pratt & Whitney, GE Aerospace, IAE LLC and IAE AG.
controles.correction_proposee: Reserve : le paragraphe source se conclut par deux contrepoids omis - "the joint liability of engine program consortia constitutes effective transfer of the risk of defects that are attributable to MTU" et "In the military engine business, MTU is largely exempt from product risk liability."

controles.affirmation: Plus de 75% de l'exposition au dollar est couverte naturellement par des couts payes en dollars ; le risque client est gere par assurance-credit et couverture Hermes
controles.verbatim_source: more than 85% of MTU's revenue is generated in U.S. dollars, whereby more than 75% of the currency risk arising from the resulting generated income is expected to be hedged naturally through expenditure in U.S. dollars. || commercial credit insurance or export credit guarantees (Hermes cover...)
controles.correction_proposee: Precision possible : l'ATT ecrit "devise de facturation majoritaire" la ou la source dit plus de 85% du chiffre d'affaires.

controles.affirmation: MTU cite la suppression de la clause de minimis americaine et la hausse des politiques tarifaires comme LE FACTEUR AYANT LE PLUS PESE SUR L'EXERCICE
controles.verbatim_source: Protectionist measures taken in some countries even before the pandemic ARE A FURTHER RISK FACTOR, ONE WHICH INCREASED SIGNIFICANTLY THIS YEAR. A key example here is the removal of the "de-minimis" clause, which enabled goods with a value less than U.S.$800 to be imported into the USA free of customs tariffs and taxes.
controles.correction_proposee: Le document classe le protectionnisme comme "un facteur de risque supplementaire, dont l'importance a nettement augmente cette annee" - jamais comme le facteur ayant le plus pese sur l'exercice. Le superlatif n'est pas dans la source, et l'ellipse de la citation ("Protectionist measures ... one which increased significantly this year") masque precisement le qualificatif attenuant "a further risk factor". Reformuler sans superlatif.
